products.title: Sony WH-CH730N Wireless Noise Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones (Black)

description.plain:
The WH-CH730N is a wireless headphone with Digital Noise Cancelling. The lightweight over-ear design is perfect for commuting and everyday music enjoyment. Long battery-life, quick charging and handsfree voice calls, with multipoint, make this headphone a smart choice for both work and pleasure.

Key Features

Bluetooth and Digital Noise Cancelling

Lightweight over-ear design can swivel and fold into a compact shape

Multipoint connectivity and clearer voice calls, using AI

Sony | Sound Connect companion app, 10-band EQ and gaming mode

DSEE music-upscaling helps restore music detail lost during compression

Up to 50 hours battery life, with Noise Cancelling, or up to 75 hours without

USB-C with quick charging (3 mins charge = 60mins of music)

LE Audio (LC3) and Auracast compatible

Supplied 3.5mm cable for wired operation

What’s in the box?
Headphones
Headphone cable (1.2m, 3.5mm jack)
Reference guide

products.title: JBL Tune 520BT Wireless on-ear Headphones - Black

description.plain:
JBL Tune 520BT Wireless On-Ear Headphones – Black

Enjoy powerful sound and all-day comfort with the JBL Tune 520BT Wireless On-Ear Headphones in Black. Featuring JBL Pure Bass Sound, these lightweight headphones deliver deep, rich audio that brings your favorite music, podcasts, and videos to life.

With Bluetooth wireless connectivity, you can easily pair the Tune 520BT with your smartphone, tablet, or laptop and enjoy hassle-free listening without tangled cables. The comfortable on-ear design and long-lasting battery life make them perfect for daily commutes, work, travel, and entertainment.

Built-in controls allow you to manage music playback, adjust volume, and answer calls directly from the headphones, while the foldable design makes them easy to carry wherever you go.

Key Features:

  • JBL Pure Bass Sound for powerful, immersive audio

  • Bluetooth wireless connectivity for seamless pairing

  • Lightweight and comfortable on-ear design

  • Extended battery life for all-day listening

  • Quick charging capability for added convenience

  • Built-in microphone for hands-free calls

  • Easy-to-use controls on the earcup

  • Foldable design for portability and storage

  • Stylish Blue finish for a vibrant, modern look

Whether you're listening at home, at work, or on the move, the JBL Tune 520BT delivers reliable wireless performance and signature JBL sound in a sleek, comfortable package.

JBL Tune 720BT: Wireless Over-Ear Headphones with 76-Hour Battery, Same Day Delivery Available in Singapore

Enjoy JBL Pure Bass Sound wirelessly with the JBL Tune 720BT, with up to 76 hours of battery life and a lightweight, foldable design for all-day listening. Shop with Metapod, an authorised JBL retailer, and enjoy a 1-year official warranty.

Key Features

  • JBL Pure Bass Sound: over Bluetooth 5.3.
  • Up to 76 hours battery: recharge in 2 hours via USB-C, and 5 minutes adds 3 hours.
  • Hands-free calls with Voice Aware: manage calls from the ear-cup buttons.
  • Multi-point connection: switch between Bluetooth devices without hassle.
  • Detachable audio cable: keep listening even when the battery runs out.

Why buy from Metapod

  • Authorised JBL partner with 1-year official warranty.
  • Same day delivery for orders before 11am.

Can I customise the sound?
Yes. Use the EQ in the JBL Headphones app, with voice prompts in your chosen language.

Which colours are available?
White, Black and Blue.

Does it come with warranty?
Yes, a 1-year official warranty.
